hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If this state's '_isDoneCrown', then
    Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy.
    Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.
    The enemy uses ability.
  Otherwise
    Set this state's '_isDoneCrown' to true.
    The enemy uses the move labelled "crown".

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy.
Let ability be a weighted random move of the enemy other than withoutAbilityList.

no.text: The enemy uses the move labelled "crown".
